probes.description: capabilities[].adapter names WHICH adapter serves a capability. selfApi declares adapter http-connector; ConnectorSelfCheckFlow calls selfApi.health. The call is dispatched to that adapter (the flow result names it as capabilityAdapterId) and the adapter fails CLOSED: its secret env var NPDEV_CONNECTOR_SELFAPI_KEY is not set in the probe run, so there is no outbound request, only a CONNECTOR_SECRET_NOT_CONFIGURED contract error. (If that env var is ever set for probe runs this probe must change: the call would then go to selfApiBaseUrl.)

steps.name: run the flow that calls the connector capability

probes.description: capabilities[].inbound opens POST /api/hooks/<name> for a third party that holds no NPDev credential (every step here sends none). payment-processor maps body.orderId to the event correlation id and publishes PaymentConfirmed. The door fails closed: an unknown source is 404, a door whose secret env var is unset (github) is 401 WEBHOOK_SECRET_NOT_CONFIGURED, and for payment-processor (the harness sets a dummy NPDEV_WEBHOOK_PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_SECRET) a missing or wrong signature is 401 and publishes NOTHING: the parked AwaitPaymentConfirmation stays WAITING_EVENT. Only the correctly signed delivery (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, header X-Npdev-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>) publishes the event and completes the flow.
